In Step 5, the agent claimed that the lines "and becomes less" and "until there is nothing left" in the third stanza are indented. However, upon reviewing the text provided in the same message, these lines are left-aligned with the rest of the stanza. The actual indented lines in the poem are found in the first stanza (specifically "have been forgotten", "nor his great hands' print", "on our evening doorknobs", "one half turn each night", "and he would come", "drabbled with the world's business", "massive and silent", "as the whole day's wish", "ready to redefine", "each of our shapes"). The agent incorrectly identified the stanza number (3 instead of 1) and the specific lines containing the indentation, likely due to a hallucination or misinterpretation of the visual layout of the text provided.
